game_identity_and_current_behavior.genre_archetype: one-screen arcade bubble shooter / match puzzle-action hybrid
game_identity_and_current_behavior.core_player_goal: clear the hanging grid by shooting matching projectiles and avoid allowing the formation to reach the lower fail threshold
game_identity_and_current_behavior.fail_state: game over occurs when a landed bubble reaches too low on the board near the bottom threshold
game_identity_and_current_behavior.success_score_state: score increases for matched bubbles and dropped floating clusters; full board clear immediately resets into another round
game_identity_and_current_behavior.camera_viewport_assumptions: single full-screen fixed viewport with canvas playfield and DOM HUD overlays
game_identity_and_current_behavior.input_model: mouse or touch drag to set angle, release to shoot upward; mute button remains separate in DOM
moment_to_moment_loop: projectile travels and can bounce off side walls
game_identity_and_current_behavior.existing_progression: no explicit levels; progression currently exists only as round continuation and score accumulation across repeated board clears

input_control_mechanic.description: drag/touch aim with release-to-fire; no alternate actions

movement_mechanic.description: projectile travels along angle, bounces on side walls, stops on ceiling or bubble contact, then snaps into grid

spawning_timing_mechanic.description: single random projectile type spawns after each landing; initial grid fills first five rows with random colors

collision_contact_mechanic.description: distance-based collision with existing bubbles plus wall and ceiling checks

scoring_progress_mechanic.description: matched bubbles award 10 each; dropped floating bubbles award 20 each; full clear restarts the board

hazard_mechanic.description: primary hazard is stack descent toward lower fail rows; non-matching shots increase crowding pressure

reward_collectible_mechanic.description: reward comes from combo-sized matches and floating cluster drops rather than pickups

level_round_state_mechanic.description: start, play, and game-over overlays wrap a repeated arcade round structure

ui_hud_feedback_mechanic.description: score HUD, start button, restart button, mute control, danger/combo reactions

audio_visual_feedback_mechanic.description: background image, orb visuals, particles, GIF overlays, sound effects, music

assessment: timing-heavy in a light arcade sense
spatial parsing heavy enough to matter
not physics-heavy beyond protected projectile bounce model
what_more_complex_should_mean: clearer magical world progression across five levels
stronger hazard/reward readability through spell-themed language
more authored visual escalation from lesson room to dangerous chamber
safer difficulty framing through conceptual level worlds and presentation-led intensity
better HUD/state messaging rather than new systems

protected_mechanics: drag to aim and release to fire
upward projectile shot with side-wall bounce
staggered grid occupancy and adjacency logic
floating-cluster drop behavior from roof connectivity
score values and loss threshold semantics
immediate round reset on board clear
safe_theming_surfaces: procedural magical overlays and environmental motifs

remix_premise.title_direction: Harry Potter inspired Hogwarts spell-cluster trial
remix_premise.world_premise: The player is a Hogwarts student or duelist in a sequence of magical chambers, using a wand focus to launch enchanted spell spheres into suspended cursed formations. Matching like spell types dispels them, while unsupported clusters collapse out of the enchantment. Each level represents a different lesson or dangerous Hogwarts-adjacent magical space.
remix_premise.compatibility_with_source_mechanics: excellent because all core actions already map cleanly to aimed spell-shot puzzle play

level_1.name: First-Year Charms Trial
level_1.definition: Base transformed experience. The existing game becomes an introductory Hogwarts practice chamber where the player clears simple enchanted charm clusters with bright, readable spell orbs and calm magical ambience.

level_1_5.name: Moving Stair Lantern Test
level_1_5.definition: First meaningful escalation. The mechanics remain unchanged, but the presentation introduces denser magical weather, stronger danger copy, and a more reactive enchanted corridor look that proves the world can escalate between rounds without requiring new systems.

one_point_five_level_core.progression_proof: If the game can move safely from a calm charm classroom to a more unstable moving-stair corridor only through visuals, feedback intensity, and framing, then it can scale into five recognizable magical worlds without breaking mechanics.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: First-Year Charms Trial
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Clear the charm cluster and keep the classroom field stable.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Introduce the magical reskin in the cleanest, most readable form.
safe_mechanics_knobs: none required in this planning stage
if later safe knobs exist, prefer gentler initial board color readability only
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Hazards are unstable charms; rewards are clean spell dispels and dropped cursed links.
five_level_difficulty_progression.ui_hud_messaging: Lesson framing, calm spell practice, score labeled as house points or spell score.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: Do not overdecorate early level and reduce shot readability.
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: Warm candlelit classroom with floating feather quills and soft stained-glass glow.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Moving Stair Lantern Test
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Clear the enchanted stairwell cluster before magical lanterns dim out.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Introduce stronger tension and vertical castle depth while preserving the same arcade loop.
safe_mechanics_knobs: optionally slightly denser intro copy urgency if later stages keep readability
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Hazards are unstable stairwell curses; rewards are lantern rekindles and sigil bursts.
five_level_difficulty_progression.ui_hud_messaging: Stairwell alert language and clearer warning state language.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: Do not animate the background so heavily that aim cues are obscured.
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: Castle stair hall with moving shadows, lantern glows, and drifting parchment.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Potions Vault Convergence
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Dispel clustered potion reactions before the vault overcharges.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Present the full intended magical stack: denser magical color language, stronger particles, clearer combo fantasy.
safe_mechanics_knobs: if safe later, stronger combo feedback emphasis only
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Hazards are unstable potion globes and chain reactions; rewards are successful brews collapsing into score-rich drops.
five_level_difficulty_progression.ui_hud_messaging: Potion pressure and spell-chain success wording.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: Color coding must remain clearer than thematic potion styling.
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: Cauldron-lit vault with vapor curls, alchemical glyph circles, and bottle shimmer.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Forbidden Corridor Wards
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Break through cursed ward clusters in a dark corridor before the curse line descends.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Same essential gameplay stack under more emotional pressure and darker framing.
safe_mechanics_knobs: higher perceived pressure through audiovisual tone
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Hazards are cursed ward seals; rewards are dispelled corridor seals and collapsing dark links.
five_level_difficulty_progression.ui_hud_messaging: Danger-forward copy and stronger fail-state identity.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: Darkness cannot hide orb colors or board edges.
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: Moonlit corridor with cracked stone, drifting dust, and ominous ward glows.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Chamber of Spellstorms
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Survive and clear the final spellstorm formation in the deepest magical chamber.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Upper readable pressure in presentation and atmosphere while keeping the puzzle readable and stable.
safe_mechanics_knobs: maximum visual drama within readability limits
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Hazards are storm-charged curse nodes; rewards are chamber-wide dispel bursts and dramatic floating collapses.
five_level_difficulty_progression.ui_hud_messaging: Final trial language without implying a new boss mechanic.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: Do not let spectacle overwhelm target readability or mobile usability.
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: Grand storm chamber with towering windows, lightning veins, and dense magical debris arcs.
